### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import pandas as pd

def ds1_pandas_rolling_revenue(orders: list, window: int = 3) -> list:
    df = pd.DataFrame(orders).sort_values("day").reset_index(drop=True)
    df["rolling_revenue"] = df["amount"].rolling(window=int(window), min_periods=1).sum().round(4)
    df["rolling_aov"] = df["amount"].rolling(window=int(window), min_periods=1).mean().round(4)
    return df[["day", "rolling_revenue", "rolling_aov"]].to_dict(orient="records")
```
